item.description:
### New
- The player can go full screen. Click the full-screen button at the top right, press F, or double-click the picture. Esc takes you back to a window, and closing the player does too.
### Changed
- The zoom button in the player is gone; full screen takes its place. F now goes full screen instead of switching between fit and fill. - Double-clicking the picture goes full screen instead of skipping 10 seconds. The arrow keys and J and L still skip.
